name: Murasakino Maya
source:
The proud, mischievous, female executive of the evil organization.
She dismisses love, romance, and sex as the inferior acts of a lesser race.
She usually has the power to overwhelm the Pure Knights, but she struggles after they became the protagonist's playthings.
She eventually tries to destroy the protagonist, but...
